transformers.name: Event envelope
transformers.description: JSON: { event, subscription, sentAt, items: [{ id, type, values }] } with plain values instead of attribute objects.

transformers.name: Flat values
transformers.description: JSON array: [{ id, type, <attribute>: <value>, ... }], one object per entity.

transformers.name: InfluxDB line protocol
transformers.description: Text: <type>,id=<entityId> <numeric attributes> <timestamp in ns>. Non-numeric attributes are skipped.
